entities.name: Uładzimier Brovikaw
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimir Ignatevich Brovikov was the Chairman of the Council of Ministers of Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic from 8 July 1983 to 10 January 1986. He was preceded by Aleksandr Aksyonov and succeeded by Mikhail Kovalyov.
